notes.title: Introducing No Rest for the Weary!
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm the developer of Winnie-The-Pooh Taste Test and I'm now creating a whole new game! No Rest for the Weary is a 2D Action RPG Inspired by Persona and 2D Zelda games. It's very different from Winnie-The-Pooh Taste Test, but if you are interested you should check out the Steam page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3529140/No_Rest_for_the_Weary/

Thank you,
Tumble Arts.
